title: Answer.AI finds Devin completed 3 of 20 real tasks in a month of use
summary: Hamel Husain, Isaac Flath and Johno Whitaker of Answer.AI gave Cognition's Devin 20 tasks over about a month: 3 succeeded, 14 failed and 3 were inconclusive. Failures included overly complex code, a security review that hallucinated issues that were not there, tangential answers to a research task, and over a day spent trying to deploy multiple apps to a single Railway deployment, which Railway does not support; the authors concluded that the agent's autonomy became a liability and that they could not predict which tasks would succeed.
verification_note: URL fetched on 2026-10-17. Page title 'Thoughts On A Month With Devin', dated January 8, 2025, by Hamel Husain, Isaac Flath and Johno Whitaker on Answer.AI. The 20-task tally (14 failures, 3 inconclusive, 3 successes), the Railway deployment attempt lasting over a day, the hallucinated security-review issues and the over-complex code examples were confirmed from the article body and appendix.
